name: mnemyx
description: Local-first MCP server giving AI coding assistants a searchable memory of your real shell history
author: Noah Menezes

scripts.build: bun build ./src/cli.ts ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --packages external && cp ./src/dashboard/page.html ./dist/page.html && chmod +x ./dist/cli.js ./dist/index.js
scripts.build:binaries: mkdir -p ./dist-bin && for target in linux-x64 linux-arm64 darwin-x64 darwin-arm64; do bun build ./src/cli.ts --outfile ./dist-bin/mnemyx-$target --target bun-$target --compile --asset ./src/dashboard/page.html && bun build ./src/index.ts --outfile ./dist-bin/mnemyx-server-$target --target bun-$target --compile; done
